description: This Kotlin source file defines the HomeFragment class, which is a UI component for an Android TV app. It displays horizontally scrolling carousels of recipes grouped by category, manages user interactions such as clicking on recipes to view details, and includes a ViewModel for data handling and retrieval from a RecipeRepository.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays horizontal carousels of recipes grouped by category, allowing user interaction to view recipe details.

classes.name: HomeViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel managing recipe data, fetching categories and recipes from the repository, and exposing data to the UI.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the fragment, sets UI properties, and starts observing data.

methods.name: setupUI
methods.description: Configures the adapter and item click listener for the UI.

methods.name: observeData
methods.description: Triggers data loading and observes changes to update the UI.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads categories and recipes asynchronously and updates the LiveData.
